extractions.value: Clinical features resembling Stiff-Person-Syndrome (lower extremity dysfunction secondary to tonically active agonist and antagonist muscles, hyperreflexia, extensor plantar responses, pain with movement), EMG showing continuous motor unit activity of both agonist and antagonist muscles, positive ANNA-3 antibody, exclusion of other causes (normal CSF, MRI spine without cord inflammation/compression), and response to treatment (improvement with diazepam and cancer therapy).
extractions.quote: The clinical features of our patient resemble Stiff-Person-Syndrome (SPS) ... EMG did reveal continuous motor unit activity of both agonist and antagonist muscles. ... A paraneoplastic panel of antibodies was obtained ...
